sql: select (select count(*) from live_paper_twins) as twins, (select count(*) from live_paper_twins where ended_at is null) as open_twins, (select count(*) from mmsell_position_ticks) as ticks_all, (select count(*) from mmsell_position_ticks where captured_at >= now() - interval '30 days') as ticks_30d, (select count(distinct market_ticker) from mmsell_position_ticks where captured_at >= now() - interval '30 days') as tickers_30d, (select count(*) from paper_trades where legacy = false) as paper_trades_live, (select count(*) from live_orders) as live_orders, (select count(*) from fills) as fills, (select count(*) from positions) as position_snapshots
